executing.name: Executing
executing.description: People with dominant Executing themes know how to make things happen. They implement ideas and turn thoughts into action.

influencing.name: Influencing
influencing.description: People with dominant Influencing themes know how to take charge, speak up, and make sure the team is heard. They help the team reach a broader audience.

relationship_building.name: Relationship Building
relationship_building.description: People with dominant Relationship Building themes build strong relationships that hold a team together. They create groups that are greater than the sum of their parts.

strategic_thinking.name: Strategic Thinking
strategic_thinking.description: People with dominant Strategic Thinking themes absorb and analyze information that informs better decisions. They stretch the team's thinking for the future.
